The zl objects on the left have a new max list length set, the zl objects in the middle use the @zlmaxsize attribute to do the same thing, and the objects on the right do not have a max list length set at all. Note that this change is not global, as shown by the difference in results for the list processing that follow the addition of the argument

The default maximum list length for zl objects input and output is 256. You can change the maximum list length limit using an optional integer argument for all modes of operation for the zl object. The arguments take the form zl <length limit> <mode> <list size>. Alternately, the @zlmaxsize attribute can be used. The maximum list length limit is 32,767.
